Researchers are exploring how to control the behavior of these quantum systems to create next-generation technologies for imaging, sensing, computing, modeling and communication. Quantum information science touches nearly all areas of science and engineering, relying on advances in the physical sciences, materials science, computer science, mathematics and engineering.
